title: How to Create a Download Link With a Button
text:
## How to Create a Download Link With a Button
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076482
In this article, we will be going over how to create a download link with the button on a webpage.
This can be extremely helpful when creating a webpage that offers an Ebook or any kind of PDF download.

## Uploading a PDF file via Media Manager
To accomplish this, simply navigate to My Content >> Media Manager >> Click the " Upload Image or PDF " button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124822517/original/Yt7mv3ZU-NQL2BsWio3UGdL3CX-Ln3pmeg.jpeg?1682978778 | alt: ]
Click or Drop Files to Upload :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125285730/original/1tygozLXs8PjKpLdBh1nUNrbB73k4PpKuw.png?1683755969 | alt: ]
And click Back to All Media after the upload is completed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125285872/original/Scw9JNHpBO5g0Al6FJBQ2Q9LZpaKKkfQ7Q.png?1683756081 | alt: ]
Then right-click on the file and select Copy URL :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125285959/original/Bha2e4QMUxclGjy9THAIzpsnDf0TNfj7Sw.png?1683756189 | alt: ]
Copy the relative URL:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125285929/original/QFoDwVjbbQsTtXiQ-oOPaje8EXJZqDGmcA.png?1683756173 | alt: ]

## Creating a Download Link with a Button
Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> Click on " New Web Page " or click " Edit " on the existing page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124822563/original/6AqkQGlpn2ff0ea5Jd6-MwzRuzqDA3oncw.png?1682978825 | alt: ]
On this new web page or on the existing page, drag and drop Button Link from Pre-Made Elements :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973073/original/cg5OJZQzEuNqh8VpiLM3yY_VO5CU6NHDqA.png?1783981709 | alt: ]
Once the button is added, click on Edit Link :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973082/original/44Wd0iN-7-4jQoWGIkadKG9vtfYR-aFDKA.png?1783981728 | alt: ]
Insert the copied PDF link, change the button label, then select Update .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973123/original/vUZq_Y8sf4e11xDuUzDkkWGdATw2MFybwQ.png?1783981851 | alt: ]
Add a unique URL to the page and click on Save Web Page :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973354/original/7E9AXZZQQQ_IXs9XVCfBS1O2fys6wFNiCw.png?1783981982 | alt: ]
This is how it would function on the front end when clicked:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125286447/original/1i5oXsox_5ng0uTxzM_yU8I_G-E9hB-o7Q.png?1683756980 | alt: ]
PDF can be downloaded by clicking on the download icon:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124822606/original/DxOuLYjDYDRcje7Oa4MJE8HOgp4aiy6zZA.jpeg?1682978884 | alt: ]

## Bonus Step (Optional) - How to Force Instant Download When Button is Clicked
This file also can be downloaded on the fly without opening a new tab as shown below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125286583/original/aFcsNmi52Wr3uFlA3GAMLv8UZvHzta8BWg.png?1683757332 | alt: ]
To accomplish this, click on the Code View icon on Web Page Builder:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973375/original/OKCh3w3lfrHQN7UsmDQwzG57Walp6vEkyQ.png?1783982058 | alt: ]
And include the download attribute just before the closing " > " as shown below, then save your changes again:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181973441/original/tYAUatNt75d-StoC0zoW6JY7Xyv-eveBRw.png?1783982159 | alt: ]
